statuses.implemented: Software for the requirement is complete; only acceptance in other evidence classes remains.
statuses.partial: Some software exists and named software gaps remain.
statuses.deferred: Out of the MVP by recorded policy.
statuses.blocked: Cannot progress without an external decision, resource or artifact.

note: Status is software state, not acceptance. Evidence lists source and test paths that implement or check the requirement; they are not passing results. Each gate names the next evidence class required.

requirements.title: Distinct branded home, app grid and assistant entry; independent package and storage identity
requirements.gate: E: launcher HOME-role instrumentation on both APKs, then D on the selected phone
requirements.remaining: Home has no all-apps drawer or search, so installed third-party apps cannot be opened from it.

requirements.title: Standalone and HOME APKs from one source; offline shell; stock settings and recovery accessible
requirements.gate: B: four distribution APKs build and pass scripts/verify-apks.mjs; then E: install both modes, open apps and return HOME repeatedly
requirements.remaining: The Android build fails at the pinned calendar plugin. The Welcome dialog's local-apps entry is covered only by a stubbed-bridge browser test, not on a device.

requirements.title: Existing Eliza sign-in and pairing with an approved Alpha routing adapter and owner-scoped credentials
requirements.gate: R and D: real-device wrong-owner and wrong-origin, expired and reused token, and callback tests against the managed endpoint (A-02)
requirements.remaining: Production Android pairing is retired by design. Cloud self-revocation on sign-out and the native pairing-route guard have synthetic and JVM coverage only: no live Eliza Cloud revocation, APK or device run. The web build cannot sign in to or revoke Eliza Cloud.

requirements.title: Android-resident agent execution with hosted Qwen inference on Cerebras, honest offline state and reconnect/history restoration
requirements.gate: E then D: resident process restart and reconnect without duplicate messages or writes; no inference-available claim without provider health evidence
requirements.remaining: Cancellation is transport-only, and remote and Cloud history is not restored on connect.

requirements.title: Pill, input, overlay and full assistant modes with keyboard and navigation continuity
requirements.gate: S: composer draft survives every pre-dispatch failure; then E: resize, Back and HOME without keyboard obstruction
requirements.remaining: The composer consumes the draft before dispatch, so a pre-dispatch failure loses the text from the composer.

requirements.title: Voice entry and cancellation with explicit microphone state and typing fallback
requirements.gate: E: LocalSpeechInstrumentedTest passes on x86_64 and arm64-v8a; then D: physical audio, interruption and latency (A-10)
requirements.remaining: Speech functional acceptance failed on arm64-v8a and x86_64 execution is unverified.

requirements.title: Daily overview with real agenda, attention items and briefs
requirements.gate: R: real provider agenda and digests with loading, empty, stale and error states; then D
requirements.remaining: Agenda comes from on-device calendars only, and schedules are digest-only.

requirements.title: Phone, messages and contacts
requirements.gate: A recorded scope change, then native role, permission and return-to-HOME acceptance
requirements.remaining: Deferred by the MVP profile; entries and actions are disabled.

requirements.title: Inbox and calendar
requirements.gate: R: real Google OAuth grant, managed Cloud Gmail routes and a real mailbox; B: the native calendar plugin compiles at the pin
requirements.remaining: Gmail OAuth code exchange returns 401, Calendar shows only on-device calendars, and the native calendar plugin does not compile at the pin.

requirements.title: Browser, camera, photos, maps, notes and files
requirements.gate: E: browser sign-in, private-tab, pop-up and app-link instrumentation (P-04) and password-manager fill (P-05); then R and D
requirements.remaining: Native camera lacks image import and the multi-page scan builder, and the regional Maps gateway is not in production.

requirements.title: Workflow library and run history
requirements.gate: E then D: interrupted-worker behavior on the resident runtime with real receipts
requirements.remaining: Phone workflows have manual triggers only, and the resident interrupted-worker case is unqualified.

requirements.title: Settings: accounts, privacy, connection, voice, theme, text and notifications
requirements.gate: E: each Android settings handoff and readback; no simulated switches
requirements.remaining: Quick-setting tiles show no native state and open generic Android Settings.

requirements.title: Wallet and security/attestation surfaces
requirements.gate: Provider, key custody, device security and transaction-approval decisions (A-08) before any work
requirements.remaining: Deferred; no attestation claim without verified evidence.

requirements.title: Signed AOSP image and update/rollback path for one selected phone SKU
requirements.gate: I and D: exact source, blob, kernel and signer lock, hardware checklist and recovery test; blocked on hardware (A-01) and signing authority (A-06)
requirements.remaining: No selected phone SKU and no controlled release key.

requirements.title: Accessibility and resilience
requirements.gate: E then D: TalkBack, large font, touch and keyboard, offline, killed process, rotation and repeated HOME navigation
requirements.remaining: No landscape layout, and physical TalkBack and accessibility acceptance remain.
